title: OneCoin Concept Basic Presentation Urdu
description: Join now and be a part of world growing digital cryptocurrency. Future of Money is CryptoCurrency and OneCoin is next BitCoin.

asr.full_text: and due to limited supply, when its demand increases, its rate will automatically increase and people will gain a lot of profits by increasing the rate. At that time, Satoshi might not have had this idea that the rate of Bitcoin can go up to $1100. In 2014, the value of one Bitcoin reached $1100. Then in 2014-2015, Bitcoin and cryptocurrency gained a prominent recognition in the world. In January 2013, the rate of Bitcoin went from $14 to $1045. And from $1045 it went down to $14 and then went up to $1045. And during this time, it split in between 75 times. And 75 times its rate went up and down, so Bitcoin gave people 75 opportunities to become millionaires and billionaires. executive trader level 4 3000 euro Tycoon trader level 5 5000 euro any package you are purchasing you are being provided with training and you get free of cost tokens in your account any package you buy according to that package you get tokens in your account how these tokens will work for you I have selected one package for example because it's a 3 week promotion for Christmas and New Year so you will get 11,000 tokens Difficulty rate is that you will get 1 coin for 40 tokens As soon as you upgrade the package you have the option to submit these 11,000 tokens to the company's online exchange and put them in the mining pool if we assume that in next 2-3 months its rate will not increase and it will stay stable here if its rate increases to 5 or 6 euros and you trade your 275 coins for 6 euros for example then you are earning 1650 euros so the training you have taken you also got it on cryptocurrency then these calculations are just to explain you. One option was that as soon as you upgrade the package, you put all the tokens on the mining and immediately got 275 one coin. The second option is that you do not put them on the mining immediately and you wait for the split. Inshallah, I will tell you about the marketing plan in part 2. And InshaAllah next week, same time I will meet you again on the basic presentation. Thank you very much. Take care of yourself. It's Naveed Hussain signing off from OneCoin presentation. Allah Hafiz.

textual.observation: The source invites viewers to join a digital cryptocurrency, describes OneCoin as the next Bitcoin, and claims that increasing demand will automatically raise its rate and create substantial profits.

evidence.quote: Join now and be a part of world growing digital cryptocurrency.
when its demand increases, its rate will automatically increase and people will gain a lot of profits

textual.context: Presented as a promotional cryptocurrency presentation; the records do not show an explicit warning or denial.
textual.potential_relevance: The join-now invitation is paired with an endorsement claim and a promised profit relationship based on cryptocurrency price appreciation.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish the actual value, legitimacy, affiliation, or future performance of OneCoin, or whether viewers obtained any profit.

textual.observation: The presentation links paid package purchases or upgrades to training, free tokens, submission of tokens to a company exchange and mining pool, and an example of earning 1650 euros.

evidence.quote: any package you are purchasing you are being provided with training and you get free of cost tokens in your account
As soon as you upgrade the package you have the option to submit these 11,000 tokens to the company's online exchange and put them in the mining pool

textual.context: The return is presented through a package-based example and is associated with a stated three-week Christmas and New Year promotion.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated monetary return is linked to purchasing or upgrading a package and then moving tokens through an online exchange and mining-pool process.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish that the packages, tokens, exchange, mining pool, or 1650-euro return were available, executable, or realized; the example's fees and other conditions are not provided.

textual.observation: The presentation describes an immediate conversion path in which upgrading a package and placing all tokens into mining produces 275 OneCoin, alongside an alternative of waiting for a split.

evidence.quote: as soon as you upgrade the package, you put all the tokens on the mining and immediately got 275 one coin
you do not put them on the mining immediately and you wait for the split

textual.context: The speaker presents two alternatives as part of the explanation and does not state that either outcome has occurred.
textual.potential_relevance: The package-upgrade action is connected to an immediate token-to-coin outcome or to waiting for a stated split event, creating a conditional benefit pathway for later review.
textual.limitations: The timing, mechanics, value, and occurrence of the conversion or split are not established by these records.

visual.observation: A product-package table shows paid tiers from EUR 100 to EUR 5,000 associated with increasing OneToken and AGC coin allocations. A related slide shows a Pro Trader amount of 1030, 10,000 tokens including a 1,000-token promotion, 275 OC, and calculations yielding 1,650 EUR and 1,091 EUR.
visual.context: Presented within a OneCoin product and mining-pool slide sequence; whether the material is promotional or educational is unclear from the sampled frames.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible relationship between paying for a package and receiving token/coin allocations with calculated euro outcomes conditionally merits review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish that any payment occurred, that the calculations were achieved, or that the stated amounts were actually redeemable.

visual.observation: A table titled 'Trading Strategies – General Description' pairs short-term, long-term, and balanced strategies with stated holding periods or actions, including selling tokens, joining OneCoin mining pools, and reinvesting tokens. It displays EUR profit ranges for Pro Trader and Tycoon packages, including ranges extending into the hundreds of thousands of euros.
visual.context: The slide presents strategy descriptions, time periods, and profit ranges as general guidance; the surrounding presentation context is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: Specific trading, holding, mining-pool, and reinvestment actions are visibly linked to stated EUR profit ranges, creating a conditional return claim for review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show an audience being directly asked to act, any completed transaction, or any realized profit.

visual.observation: A 'OneCoin Growth Potential' chart asks where OneCoin will be in one year and plots a base scenario near EUR 2.50 and an optimistic scenario near EUR 5.00 from an initial point near EUR 0.50.
visual.context: The slide includes a visible disclaimer stating that the price chart is based solely on predictions and that achievement depends on the commitment and effort of community members.
visual.potential_relevance: Projected future price levels are linked to a one-year time horizon and may create an expectation of potential appreciation.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish that the projections were accurate, guaranteed, or connected to an actual purchase or investment request.

visual.observation: A slide labels Dr. Ruja Ignatova as 'OneCoin Founder' and places that claim beside Forbes branding and listed Oxford, University of Konstanz, and McKinsey & Company background credentials.
visual.context: The identity and credential claims appear in the same sampled presentation sequence as OneCoin package and profit-potential slides; whether this is promotional or informational is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: A named founder identity and external-credential claims are visibly presented alongside package and return material, creating an authority or endorsement cue linked to the offer.
visual.limitations: The frames do not verify the person's identity, the publication branding, the credentials, or whether the claims constituted an endorsement.

evidence.quote: if we assume that in next 2-3 months its rate will not increase and it will stay stable here
then these calculations are just to explain you

textual_context_notes.observation: The presentation refers to a limited-duration promotion tied to Christmas and New Year.

evidence.quote: because it's a 3 week promotion for Christmas and New Year

visual_context_notes.observation: The mining-pool calculation slide visibly states that the calculation is for illustration purposes only.
The growth-potential slide visibly qualifies its price chart as prediction-based and dependent on community commitment and effort.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes buying OneCoin packages and placing the resulting tokens into a mining pool while presenting projected coin-price increases and large euro profits as reasons to participate. The speaker explicitly explains how a package could produce 275 coins and calculates earnings of 1650 euros, while the description urges viewers to join and become part of the growing cryptocurrency. Although one slide labels a calculation as illustrative, the overall presentation is an affirmative sales pitch for paid packages linked to mining and token appreciation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because the presentation links paid packages costing up to 5000 euros to tokens, mining-pool participation and projected returns. S05 is separately supported because the presentation also promotes token value appreciation and trading profits.

evidence.observation: The speaker links upgrading a paid package and receiving tokens with placing those tokens in the company's mining pool.
evidence.quote: As soon as you upgrade the package you have the option to submit these 11,000 tokens to the company's online exchange and put them in the mining pool

evidence.observation: The speaker calculates a large euro earning outcome from the package-token-mining example.
The supplied description directly encourages viewers to join OneCoin as part of the promotional message.
evidence.quote: Join now and be a part of world growing digital cryptocurrency.

evidence.observation: The product-packages slide visibly lists paid packages from EUR 100 to EUR 5,000, with increasing token allocations and package levels including Pro Trader, Executive Trader and Tycoon Trader.
The OneCoin Growth Potential slide visibly projects a rise from approximately EUR 0.5 to EUR 2.50 or EUR 5.00 over one year.

The trading-strategies slide visibly lists profit ranges, including amounts as high as EUR 235,000-475,000 for a Tycoon long-term strategy, and describes maximizing profit through OneCoin mining pools.
